name: The Greenwarden
summary: First Mate Fitzsimmons sends Alliance travelers from Menethil Harbor northeast into the Wetlands marshes. They seek a mysterious being rumored to dwell among the beasts.

sections.title: Tavern Rumors and Bog Tales
sections.body: Sailors and wanderers at Menethil Harbor trade stories of a beast lurking in the swamp. First Mate Fitzsimmons describes the Greenwarden as an appetite with legs and calls those who seek it gullible. Leave the dry road, he warns, and “ol’ Greenie” will bite you in two. To the folk on the docks, anything huge in the murky waters is another man-eating danger in the marsh.

sections.title: The Guardian of the Marsh
sections.body: East of the fork toward Dun Modr, Rethiel watches over the Wetlands as the Greenwarden. This towering ancient is bound to the wild growth there, not a mindless carnivore. From afar, he watches the sorrow of the spoiled land and calls on willing mortals to cleanse the blighted marsh.

faq.answer: The Greenwarden is Rethiel, an ancient nature guardian in the Wetlands. Sailors along the coast mistake him for a savage monster, but he protects the plants and wildlife.

faq.q: Where can I find the Greenwarden?
faq.answer: Rethiel is in the marshlands east of the main road, near the fork toward Dun Modr in the northern Wetlands.

faq.q: Why does First Mate Fitzsimmons think the Greenwarden is dangerous?
faq.answer: Fitzsimmons knows only the tavern rumors and superstitions of Menethil Harbor. With beasts overrunning the Wetlands, sailors assume any giant among the crocodiles and predators is a man-eating brute.

faq.q: What does Rethiel want with travelers?
faq.answer: Rethiel seeks champions to tend the Wetlands, which he says weep from festered wounds. He directs travelers to protect the wildlife and quell threats to the local ecosystem.

faq.q: What happens after finding the Greenwarden?
faq.answer: When you speak with Rethiel, he says nature speaks well of you, then gives you “Tramping Paws” to help with the troubles in the marsh.

faq.q: Does this quest require fighting anything to complete?
faq.answer: No. You need only survive the trek through the Wetlands and speak with Rethiel at his grove in the marsh.

angles.text: Dockworkers may see Rethiel as a swamp monster, but druids recognize an ancient guardian attuned to nature’s balance.
As a night elf far from Kalimdor, you may find a familiar, comforting echo of nature’s ancient wardens in the damp, muddy soils of Khaz Modan.
